defects.title: Character Segmentation Failure in Low-Resolution Odia Ligatures
defects.description: In scans below 200 DPI, complex Odia conjoined glyphs (e.g. ksha, tra) fuse horizontally, causing Tesseract to emit fragmented character tokens.
defects.remediation: Adaptive 300 DPI upscaling applied via adaptive_ocr pre-processing for Odia scripts.

defects.title: Narrow Gutter Label-Value Bleed in Complex Multi-Column Gazettes
defects.description: When multi-column gutters are narrower than 8 pixels, column boundary detection occasionally merges adjacent column tokens.
defects.remediation: Spatial layout engine enforces 5-pixel minimum vertical gutter thresholds with whitespace projection profiling.

defects.title: Confusable Glyphs in Micro-Font Bank IFSC Branches
defects.description: Micro-font (sub-10px) scans of passbooks frequently confuse O and 0 at index 4.
defects.remediation: Loop 27/33 confusable glyph validation strictly forces ABSTAIN (REVIEW), preventing false verifications.
